question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a teal present, Bob has a blue present, and Claire has a gold present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Claire and Alice swap their gifts. Then, Claire and Alice swap their gifts. Finally, Bob and Claire swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Claire has the
Options:
(A) teal present
(B) blue present
(C) gold present
solution:
Present colors are listed in order: Alice, Bob, Claire.
Initial: (teal, blue, gold)
1. Claire and Alice swap: (gold, blue, teal)
2. Claire and Alice swap: (teal, blue, gold)
3. Bob and Claire swap: (teal, gold, blue)
Claire has the blue present, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
